location: Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte
headline: Aquaculture Technician
summary: Aquaculture technician with four years running tilapia and milkfish ponds and fish cages in Maguindanao. I plan stocking and feeding with pond management software, monitor water quality and currents at cage sites, and keep harvests hygienic from pond to market. I also work with fishers on gear and catch records.
skills: Aquaculture operations: ponds and fish cages
Reading water currents for cage placement
Knowledge of the local fishing industry

experience.title: Aquaculture Technician
experience.location: Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte
bullets: Manage stocking, feeding and sampling for 12 hectares of tilapia and milkfish ponds.
Plan production cycles and feed use in pond management software.
Check water quality daily and position fish cages to make use of currents.
Supervise harvests and keep fish iced and clean until delivery.
Record catch and gear use with member fishers for the cooperative's fisheries plan.

experience.title: Hatchery Assistant
bullets: Fed fry and fingerlings and cleaned tanks in a tilapia hatchery.
Counted and packed fingerlings for farmers.
